style:
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  background-color: #f8f7f4;
  color: #2d3436;
  font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 960px;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] body {
  background-color: #1a1a2e;
  color: #e0dcd5;
}

#header {
  border-bottom: 2px solid #4a6fa5;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
}

.postTitle {
  color: #2d3436;
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: 700;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  margin: auto 0;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] .postTitle {
  color: #e0dcd5;
}
.postTitle::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 60px;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4a6fa5, transparent);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

#postBody {
  line-height: 1.9;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #2d3436;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody {
  color: #e0dcd5;
}

#postBody h2 {
  color: #2d3436;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e0dcd5;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  margin-top: 2.2em;
  font-size: 24px;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody h2 {
  color: #e0dcd5;
  border-bottom-color: #2d3436;
}

#postBody h3 {
  color: #4a6fa5;
  margin-top: 1.8em;
  font-size: 20px;
  padding-left: 14px;
  border-left: 3px solid #4a6fa5;
}

#postBody p {
  margin: 1em 0;
}

#postBody table {
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #e0dcd5;
  margin: 1.5em 0;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody table {
  border-color: #2d3436;
}
#postBody table th {
  background: #4a6fa5;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
#postBody table td {
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-color: #e0dcd5;
  font-size: 14px;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody table td {
  border-color: #2d3436;
}
#postBody table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background-color: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.04);
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background-color: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.08);
}
#postBody table tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.08);
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody table tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.15);
}

#postBody code {
  background: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.08);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  color: #4a6fa5;
  font-size: 0.9em;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody code {
  background: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.15);
  color: #7da2c9;
}

#postBody pre {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #e0dcd5;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody pre {
  border-color: #2d3436;
}

#postBody blockquote {
  border-left: 4px solid #4a6fa5;
  background: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.05);
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin: 1.5em 0;
  color: #636e72;
  font-style: italic;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #postBody blockquote {
  background: rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.1);
  color: #a0a8b4;
}

#postBody a {
  color: #4a6fa5;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(74, 111, 165, 0.3);
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
}
#postBody a:hover {
  border-bottom-color: #4a6fa5;
}

.title-right a, .title-right button {
  transition: color 0.2s;
}
.title-right a:hover, .title-right button:hover {
  color: #4a6fa5 !important;
}

#footer {
  border-top: 1px solid #e0dcd5;
  padding-top: 20px;
  color: #636e72;
  margin-top: 48px;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #footer {
  border-top-color: #2d3436;
  color: #a0a8b4;
}
#footer a {
  color: #4a6fa5;
  text-decoration: none;
}

#post-toc {
  position: fixed;
  right: 20px;
  top: 100px;
  width: 240px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 140px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 20px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e0dcd5;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  font-size: 13px;
  z-index: 10;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #post-toc {
  background: #16213e;
  border-color: #2d3436;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}
#post-toc-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #636e72;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e0dcd5;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #post-toc-title {
  color: #a0a8b4;
  border-bottom-color: #2d3436;
}
#post-toc a {
  display: block;
  color: #636e72;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 5px 0 5px 0;
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  padding-left: 10px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
[data-color-mode="dark"] #post-toc a {
  color: #a0a8b4;
}
#post-toc a:hover {
  color: #4a6fa5;
  border-left-color: #4a6fa5;
}
#post-toc a.active {
  color: #4a6fa5;
  border-left-color: #4a6fa5;
  font-weight: 600;
}
#post-toc a.toc-h3 {
  padding-left: 24px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
#toc-toggle {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #4a6fa5;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 100;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(74,111,165,0.4);
  transition: transform 0.3s;
}
#toc-toggle:hover {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}
#toc-toggle.open {
  background: #636e72;
}
@media (max-width: 1400px) {
  #post-toc {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    right: 10px;
    top: auto;
    bottom: 76px;
    width: 260px;
    max-height: 50vh;
    z-index: 99;
  }
  #post-toc.mobile-show {
    display: block;
  }
  #toc-toggle {
    display: block;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  body { padding: 12px; }
  .postTitle { font-size: 26px; }
}
</style>
